title: Which Gospel Writer Are You?
subtitle: Four friends told one story four ways. Whose pen sounds like yours?

questions.text: When you tell a story, what matters most to you?

options.text: Showing how it all connects to the bigger picture.
Getting to the point fast, with all the action.
Getting the details right and in the right order.
Sitting in the meaning of it for a while.

questions.text: A friend asks who Jesus is. You start with...

options.text: His family line, the promised King people waited for.
What He did. Watch how He moves.
How He welcomed the people everyone else skipped.
He was there in the beginning. He is the Word.

questions.text: Which word feels most like you?

options.text: Fulfilled.
Immediately.
Carefully.
Beloved.

questions.text: Whose corner are you most likely to be in?

options.text: People wrestling with their faith and their roots.
People who are tired of talk and want to see proof.
The poor, the outsider, the one left off the list.
Anyone who needs to know they are loved.

questions.text: How long are your stories, usually?

options.text: Long enough to teach a real lesson by the end.
Short. Punchy. I cut the filler.
Thorough, because I do not want to miss anything.
I slow way down on the moments that matter.

questions.text: Pick the scene you would most want to write:

options.text: A teacher on a hillside, blessing the meek.
A storm going still at one word.
A lost son running into his father's arms.
A friend weeping, then calling a dead man out of the tomb.

questions.text: What do you most want a reader to walk away with?

options.text: He is the King the whole story was pointing to.
He came to serve, and so should we.
There is room at His table for you.
Believe, and you will have life in His name.

questions.text: Someone doubts your account. You respond by...

options.text: Pointing back to what was promised long ago.
Just telling them what happened, plainly.
Showing my homework. I checked the sources.
Telling them I was there, and it is true.

matthew.name: Matthew the Bridge-Builder
matthew.description: You see how things connect. You love showing people that the story they are living was promised long before they got here. Once a tax collector on the outside, you became the one who builds bridges between where people come from and where God is taking them. When you teach, you want it to land and change someone.

scripture.text: And as Jesus passed by from thence, he saw a man, called Matthew, sitting at the place of toll: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

cardVerse.text: Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

mark.name: Mark the Fast Mover
mark.description: You do not waste words. You would rather show someone than explain to them, and you get to the point while everyone else is still clearing their throat. Your favorite word is basically immediately. People trust you because you tell it straight, and the action speaks for itself.

scripture.text: For the Son of man also came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

cardVerse.text: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.

luke.name: Luke the Careful Witness
luke.description: You check your facts and you notice the people other folks overlook. You want the record right, but you also want the door wide open for the poor, the outsider, and the one left off the guest list. Your care is its own kind of love. When you tell the story, everyone gets a seat at the table.

scripture.text: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus;

cardVerse.text: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

john.name: John the Beloved
john.description: You slow down on the things that matter and let the meaning sink in. You are not after a play-by-play, you are after the heart of it. You knew what it was to be loved up close, and that is the one thing you most want others to know too. Believe, you keep saying, and you will have life.

scripture.text: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.

cardVerse.text: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another.
